# Version 4.152.4 (Unreleased)
> **Failed flush cache cleanup**

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.204/index.md)

## Highlights

This update prevents reuse of uniquely held Ganesh cache entries after failed rendering.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Cache cleanup after failed GPU flushes** — Drops uniquely held Ganesh thread-safe cache entries after a failed flush so later draws do not reuse their uninitialized textures. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed. ([#5287](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5287))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.204

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
